records.applyRoute: apply through a current PRAYAS Centre or Advance PRAYAS Centre when its intake is open

records.title: NMDFC Micro-Finance Scheme for Minority SHGs
records.applyRoute: Form or join an eligible Self Help Group, complete thrift/credit and minority/income documentation, and apply through the relevant State Channelizing Agency under its current micro-finance process.

records.title: NMDFC Term Loan Scheme for Employment-Generating Ventures
records.applyRoute: Confirm the applicable credit line, prepare minority, income, residence, KYC and project evidence, and apply through the relevant State Channelizing Agency or banking partner.

records.title: NMDFC Virasat Credit Scheme for Craftpersons
records.applyRoute: Confirm the eligible craft/activity, prepare minority, income, residence, KYC and equipment/raw-material evidence, and apply through the relevant SCA or current NMDFC partner route.

records.title: NSFDC Income-Generating Credit Schemes
records.applyRoute: Confirm the appropriate NSFDC credit track, prepare caste/income/KYC/project evidence and apply through the PM-SURAJ route or the relevant authorized State Channelizing Agency/other channel partner.

records.title: NSIC Consortia & Tender Marketing Scheme
records.applyRoute: review the current NSIC tender/consortia route and the specific procurement notice before applying

records.title: NSTFDC Term Loan Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs
records.applyRoute: Contact the relevant State Channelising Agency or approved NSTFDC partner, prepare the viable project and ST/income/KYC evidence, and complete its appraisal route.

records.title: NSTFDC Assistance for TRIFED-empanelled Tribal Artisans
records.applyRoute: Confirm TRIFED empanelment, prepare the asset/working-capital plan and apply through the applicable NSTFDC State Channelising Agency or partner.

records.title: One District One Product (ODOP) Financial Assistance Scheme
records.applyRoute: Apply on the UP MSME portal; the District Industries Centre forwards applications to banks for loan sanction.
records.benefitHeadline: Up to 25% margin money for your district's ODOP product

rateRows.quote: For units with total project cost up to Rs. 25.00 lakh under the scheme, 25 per cent of the total project cost subject to a maximum of Rs.6.25 lakh
For units with total project cost above Rs. 25.00 lakh and up to Rs. 50.00 lakh, an amount of Rs. 6.25 lakh or 20% of the project cost, whichever is higher
For units with total project cost above Rs. 50.00 lakh and up to Rs. 150.00 lakh, an amount of Rs. 10.00 lakh or 10% of the project cost, whichever is higher
For units with total project cost exceeding Rs. 150.00 lakh, 10% of the project cost, subject to a maximum of Rs. 20.00 lakh

records.title: PAN and TAN Allocation Readiness
records.applyRoute: For a new company, review the current SPICe+ linked allocation route; for other cases, use the current official Income Tax or authorised PAN/TAN application route

records.title: Performance and Credit Rating Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises
records.applyRoute: select an applicable empanelled rating agency and submit through the NSIC or rating-agency route

records.title: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
records.applyRoute: Apply through your State or district PMFME implementation route.

records.title: RKVY-RAFTAAR NAVODAYA Agripreneurship Orientation
records.applyRoute: Find a participating R-ABI or Knowledge Partner with a live NAVODAYA or equivalent RKVY-RAFTAAR orientation notice, submit the prescribed idea/application, complete the training and incubation selection process, and retain the committee, MoU and milestone records.

records.title: RKVY-RAFTAAR SAMRIDDHI Startup Agribusiness Incubation
records.applyRoute: Find a participating R-ABI with a current SAMRIDDHI or equivalent RKVY-RAFTAAR incubation notice, submit the start-up and MVP evidence, complete incubation and committee evaluation, and execute the current grant/MoU route if selected.

records.title: Prime Minister Street Vendors AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
records.applyRoute: prepare and hand off to the official PM SVANidhi portal, Urban Local Body route, Banking Correspondent, Micro Finance Institution agent or participating lender as applicable

records.title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana - Part A First-Time Employees
records.applyRoute: Use the official PMVBRY/EPFO route for establishment and employee records; UdyamVeda only prepares the eligibility and evidence checklist.

records.title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana - Part B Employer Incentive
records.applyRoute: Confirm the establishment's EPFO code, PAN/GSTN and PAN-linked bank details, baseline and threshold records, then use the official PMVBRY/EPFO route.

records.title: PM Vishwakarma
records.applyRoute: Register through the official PM Vishwakarma portal, normally with CSC assistance, and complete the prescribed Gram Panchayat/ULB, district and committee verification process.

records.title: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Vikas Mission (PMJVM)
records.applyRoute: Identify the applicable State Tribal Department, VDVK/producer-group or TRIFED route, prepare the value-chain proposal and follow the current State or implementing-agency process.

records.title: PMMSY beneficiary-oriented subsidy
records.applyRoute: Prepare a project and apply through your district or State Fisheries Department under the PMMSY beneficiary-oriented component.

rateRows.label_en: SC/ST and women: 60%, subsidy up to ₹1.5 crore
rateRows.quote: ceiling limit of subsidy in case of SC/ST/Women – Rs.1.50 crore per project
Reviewer summary approved in P0.4: 40% of unit cost for general beneficiaries; 60% for SC/ST and women.

records.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyaan (PM-KUSUM)
records.applyRoute: apply through the designated State Government department, DISCOM or current PM-KUSUM implementing route

records.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY)
records.applyRoute: Register on NFDP as an individual or organisation through self-registration or assisted registration through a CSC, obtain the provisional certificate where applicable, then submit the component application through the official PM-MKSSY route and coordinate with the State/UT or District Fisheries Officer

records.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
records.applyRoute: Approach an eligible Member Lending Institution.

records.title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
records.applyRoute: Apply through the current official PMEGP portal and lending process.

records.title: PRIP Component A - NIPER Centres of Excellence
records.applyRoute: Identify the relevant NIPER CoE and approved collaboration route, prepare the research/infrastructure and milestone dossier, and follow the Department/CoE process

records.title: PRIP Component B - Industry, Startup and MSME Pharma-MedTech R&D Projects
records.applyRoute: Create the entity-portal application, choose early-stage or later-stage route, map the project to a priority area and TRL, prepare the technical/financial/IP/academic-collaboration dossier, and submit through the official portal

records.title: Procurement and Marketing Support (PMS) Scheme
records.applyRoute: Select the applicable event or component on the current PMS portal and follow the current official application or claim process; organizer proposals and MSE applications may use different routes.

records.title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme 2.0 for IT Hardware
records.applyRoute: Follow the current PLI Working Group/MeitY application notice and submit the prescribed application with supporting documents and application fee to the designated Project Management Agency or MeitY route.

records.title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry
records.applyRoute: review the current MHI guidelines, AAT product list, amendments and official PLI-Auto portal instructions, then use the designated route if applications or claims are available

records.title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Bulk Drugs (KSMs, DIs and APIs)
records.applyRoute: Confirm the current selected-applicant, claim and implementing-agency route with the Department of Pharmaceuticals, map the product to the controlling 41-product list, prepare greenfield investment and production evidence, and use the official route if a permitted application or claim action remains available

records.title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Promoting Domestic Manufacturing of Medical Devices
records.applyRoute: Confirm the current Department/PMA status, map the medical device to the target segment, verify project and investment conditions, and use the official application or claim route available to approved participants

records.title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
records.applyRoute: review the current Department of Pharmaceuticals notice and implementing-agency instructions, establish eligibility for the relevant target group, then use the current official application or claim route if open

records.title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Specialty Steel
records.applyRoute: Review the current Ministry notices and PLI documents, confirm whether a new invitation exists or the company is already selected, map the product and commitments to the applicable round, and use the notified Ministry or implementing-agency route

records.title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Telecom and Networking Products
records.applyRoute: review the current DoT guidelines and eServices route, identify the target segment and submit through the designated Project Management Agency process if the official application window is open

records.title: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles - Existing Participant Added-Product Track
records.applyRoute: Use the official portal's existing-participant/additional-product route only after the applicant status, current HSN list, fresh investment and window are confirmed.

records.title: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Textiles - New Applicant Track
records.applyRoute: The new-applicant route is through the Ministry of Textiles PLI portal in the notified application window; selected participants submit claims and prescribed evidence through the portal and PMA route.

records.title: Promotion of Medical Device Parks
records.applyRoute: State Government or eligible State Implementing Agency prepares the park proposal, common-infrastructure plan, project cost and implementation documents and follows the Department/Scheme Steering Committee route

records.title: Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs)
records.applyRoute: register and participate through the applicable GeM, Central buyer, tender, vendor-development or buyer-seller route

records.title: Indian Railways Procurement Access for DPIIT-Recognized Startups
records.applyRoute: Verify DPIIT recognition, monitor current Railway tenders or RailTech challenges, register as a vendor/contractor through the official IREPS route where required, and submit a tender or challenge response. Claim the applicable bid-security and prior-experience/turnover relief only in the manner permitted by the live tender.

records.title: Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RoDTEP)
records.applyRoute: claim through the current Customs/DGFT export documentation and electronic-scrip process

records.title: Revamped Pharmaceutical Technology Upgradation Assistance Scheme (RPTUAS)
records.applyRoute: Confirm the current Department/SIDBI intake and prepare the RPTUAS application, eligible-investment evidence, CA-certified expenditure statement, turnover evidence, facility details and applicable Revised Schedule M or WHO-GMP certification route. The official FAQ states that a unit can approach a scheduled commercial bank for a loan and that subsidy processing uses the scheme portal; verify the live portal before handoff.

records.title: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
records.applyRoute: eligible nodal or implementing agencies submit cluster proposals through the official portal

records.title: Scheme for Promotion of MSMEs in Defence
records.applyRoute: Download the current official scheme document, prepare the FY 2026-27 event proposal and submit through the DDP/Defence Exhibition Organisation or current authorised route stated by the department.

records.title: Self-Reliant India (SRI) Fund
records.applyRoute: An MSME should review the current NVCFL scheme guidance and approach an empanelled daughter fund whose mandate fits the enterprise. The NVCFL interest route is for prospective daughter-fund empanelment, not a direct MSME investment application.

records.title: Shipbuilding Development Scheme - Brownfield Capacity Expansion
records.applyRoute: Confirm the existing-yard eligibility, prepare the prescribed DPR and eligible-item cost plan, demonstrate financial closure, and apply through the current IA/NSbM route

records.title: Shipbuilding Development Scheme - Greenfield Shipbuilding Cluster Development
records.applyRoute: Form the eligible SPV or Central-entity proposal, prepare the prescribed DPR and infrastructure/KPI plan, obtain the required in-principle and final approvals through NSbM/IA, and follow the current DGMA or Ministry route

records.title: Shipbuilding Development Scheme - Shipbuilding Risk Coverage
records.applyRoute: Identify the approved Credit Risk Cover Agency and current product, confirm the risk and insured party, then apply through the current agency/implementation route with contract, project, vendor and financial evidence

records.title: Shipbuilding Financial Assistance Scheme (SBFAS)
records.applyRoute: Within 45 days of signing the qualifying vessel contract, apply on the SBFAS web portal, obtain the unique application number, submit the prescribed approval documents and complete Ministry/DGS verification and tranche conditions

records.title: Shop and Establishment registration (Bihar)
records.applyRoute: Apply or give intimation online on the Labour Department portal: https://serviceonline.bihar.gov.in.

records.title: Shop and Establishment registration (Delhi)
records.applyRoute: Apply or give intimation online on the Labour Department portal: https://labour.delhi.gov.in.

records.title: Shop and Establishment registration (Jharkhand)
records.applyRoute: Apply or give intimation online on the Labour Department portal: https://shramadhan.jharkhand.gov.in.

records.title: Shop and Establishment registration (Maharashtra)
records.applyRoute: Apply or give intimation online on the Labour Department portal: https://mahakamgar.maharashtra.gov.in.

records.title: Shop and Establishment registration (Uttar Pradesh)
records.applyRoute: Apply or give intimation online on the Labour Department portal: https://uplabour.gov.in.

records.title: SMDI - Capacity Building and Skill Development for Medical Devices
records.applyRoute: Eligible institution prepares course, faculty, infrastructure, candidate, industry linkage and budget proposal and submits through the current Department/PMA call

records.title: SMDI - Common Facilities for Medical Device Clusters
records.applyRoute: Check the current call, identify the eligible cluster/testing-facility entity, prepare the technical and financial proposal, and submit through the current Department/PMA route

records.title: SMDI - Marginal Investment Scheme for Reducing Import Dependence
records.applyRoute: Map the component/raw material/accessory to the current list, prepare project and import-dependence evidence, and submit through the current Department/PMA call

records.title: SMDI - Medical Device Clinical Studies Support Scheme
records.applyRoute: Prepare the device, protocol, regulatory, ethics, site, budget and investigator dossier and submit through the current Department/PMA call

records.title: SMDI - Medical Device Promotion Scheme
records.applyRoute: Prepare the activity concept, applicant credentials, participant/market plan, budget, outputs and reporting route and submit through the current Department call

records.title: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme (SCLCSS)
records.applyRoute: submit the subsidy application and required documents to the concerned Prime Lending Institution from which the term loan is availed only after current continuation is verified

records.title: Stand Up India Scheme
records.applyRoute: Apply through a Scheduled Commercial Bank and use the official handholding portal.

records.title: Startup Accelerator of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development and Growth (SAMRIDH)
records.applyRoute: apply through a current participating SAMRIDH accelerator or cohort notice

records.title: Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0
records.applyRoute: Use the applicable route: a startup approaches a selected AIF for investment, while an eligible AIF submits a proposal through the current implementing-agency route.

records.title: Startup India Investor Connect
records.applyRoute: Register or sign in through the current Startup India/BHASKAR onboarding, complete the startup profile and use the Investor Connect entry when available.

records.title: Startup India MAARG Mentorship
records.applyRoute: use the official MAARG startup application or Startup India sign-in, complete the startup profile and mentorship need, then use the current mentor-matching and connection workflow

records.title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
records.applyRoute: Apply through the Startup India portal and eligible incubators.

records.title: Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP)
records.applyRoute: Confirm coverage with the relevant State Rural Livelihoods Mission, Block Resource Centre or local SVEP implementation channel; use the official portal for programme context and authorised workflow support.

records.title: Technology Development Board Technology Commercialisation Finance
records.applyRoute: Review the current TDB funding mode, download the prescribed proposal or Loan Application Form-A, prepare the technology, IP, project-cost, remaining-funding, milestone and commercialisation evidence, and submit through the live official proposal route

records.title: Technology Incubation and Development of Entrepreneurs (TIDE 2.0)
records.applyRoute: identify a currently supported TIDE incubation centre and follow its official intake route

records.title: Trade Infrastructure for Export Scheme (TIES)
records.applyRoute: Eligible implementing agencies must follow the Department of Commerce proposal and Empowered Committee route; the claim-monitoring portal is for status visibility and is not treated as a fresh-application portal.

records.title: Udyam Registration
records.applyRoute: Use the official portal and complete the self-declaration registration with the applicant's own identity and contact details.

records.title: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Tribes (VCF-ST)
records.applyRoute: Review the current VCF-ST guideline and IFCI VCF route, prepare the startup deck, founder-status evidence, cap table and diligence material, and apply only through the notified channel.

records.title: Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP)
records.applyRoute: Register or use the relevant WEP discovery, smart-match, mentorship, access-to-finance or partner route, then follow the underlying official or partner programme instructions.

records.title: Yuva Sahakar - Cooperative Enterprise Support and Innovation Scheme
records.applyRoute: Prepare a viable cooperative project and apply through the current NCDC financing/application route, directly or through the applicable State Government/UT channel.
